content_blocks.title: A reliable way to reason about it
content_blocks.text: For RefCell<T> and Runtime Borrow Checking, write down the inputs, the guarantee you expect, and the boundary where that guarantee stops. Work through a minimal example first; then deliberately test one edge case. Box provides single ownership of heap data, Rc shares ownership in one thread, Arc shares ownership across threads, and interior mutability changes when borrowing is checked.
